name: Mahalakshmi Gayatri
text:
महालक्ष्म्यै च विद्महे विष्णुपत्न्यै च धीमहि ।
तन्नो लक्ष्मीः प्रचोदयात् ॥
meaning: We contemplate Mahalakshmi, associated with Vishnu. May Lakshmi inspire and guide us.
purpose: A Gayatri-style invocation for auspiciousness and prosperity.
when: During reflection on finances, generosity and abundance.
